analysis.title: Geopolitics, US Tech, and OATs - GS Daily Monitor
key_insights: Global equities fell on rising geopolitical concerns and mixed reactions to US tech earnings.
Tesla cut its FY capex guidance by $5bn, from $25bn to $20bn.
The Houthis claimed responsibility for attacks on the Aramco site in Yanbu and Dammam's airport.
Brent neared $112 a barrel, a 5-month high, after the US ordered non-emergency diplomatic personnel to leave Saudi Arabia over Houthi threats.
The French 10-year OAT spread over Bunds widened to 175 points, the highest level since 2011.
Turkiye's central bank cut rates for the first time since the outbreak of the Iran war.
Bank of Korea held rates steady with a presser balanced between hawkish and dovish signals. Governor Shin said the BOK would not stand in the way of recent KRW appreciation.
The US State Department ordered non-emergency personnel and their families to evacuate Saudi Arabia.
Russian President Putin held more than three hours of calls with US envoy Witkoff.
